blocks.text: If an admin has enabled privileged requests and approvals for the Privileged Remote Access (PRA) Portal, and a user has the My Approvals feature enabled, then the user can access and manage privileged requests and approvals on the My Requests and My Reviews pages. The admin must also configure a portals policy to enable requesting and reviewing approvals.

Click the My Approvals icon on the PRA Portal page to view the My Requests and My Reviews pages. The My Requests page displays the privileged approval requests that a user has created. The My Reviews page displays privileged approval requests you have permission to approve and reject. You can view the analytics of the privileged approval requests on the Requests page.
My Approvals provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: Create and manage privileged approval requests from the PRA Portal.
View the status of privileged approval requests.
Approve and reject privileged approval requests.

blocks.text: To learn more about PRA, see Understanding Privileged Remote Access. To set up PRA, see Step-by-Step Configuration Guide for Privileged Remote Access.
On the My Requests page (PRA Portal > My Approvals icon > My Requests), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Click the Home icon to go to the PRA Portal home page.
Click the My Files icon to go to the My Files page.
Click the My Approvals icon to view the My Requests and My Reviews pages.
Click the My Desktops icon to go to the My Desktops page.
Navigate the PRA Portal using the icons.
Filter the information that appears in the table. By default, no filters are applied.
The characters & and + cannot be used in the filter search field.
Create a privileged approval request.
Refresh the My Requests page to reflect the most current information.
View a list of the privileged requests. For each request, you can see:
Console: The privileged console that the privileged approval request is set for. Click a privileged approval request to see additional details.
See image.
Microtenant: The Microtenant associated with the privileged approval request.
Start Date: The set start time for access to the PRA Portal.
Requested Duration: The requested duration of time for access to the PRA Portal.
Approved Duration: The set duration of time for access to the PRA Portal. Access ends after this set time.
Status: Displays one of the following privileged approval request status types:
Pending: The privileged approval request is pending.
Approved: The privileged approval request is approved.
Expired: The privileged approval request is no longer available.
Rejected: The privileged approval request was rejected.
Delete a privileged request.
Modify the columns displayed in the table.
Display more rows or a different page of the table.
Go to the My Reviews page to approve or reject privileged approvals.

blocks.text: On the My Reviews page (PRA Portal > My Approvals icon > My Reviews), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Click the Home icon to go to the PRA Portal home page.
Click the My Files icon to go to the My Files page.
Click the My Approvals icon to view the My Requests and My Reviews pages.
Click the My Desktops icon to go to the My Desktops page.
Navigate the PRA Portal using the icons.
Filter the information that appears in the table. By default, no filters are applied.
The characters & and + cannot be used in the filter search field.
Refresh the My Reviews page to reflect the most current information.
View a list of the privileged requests. For each request, you can see:
Console: The privileged console that the privileged approval request is set for. Click a privileged approval request to see additional details.
See image.
Requester: The user who requested the privileged approval.
Microtenant: The Microtenant associated with the privileged approval request.
Start Date: The set start time for access to the PRA Portal.
Requested Duration: The requested duration of time for access to the PRA Portal.
Approved Duration: The set duration of time for access to the PRA Portal. Access ends after this set time.
Status: Displays one of the following privileged approval request status types:
Pending: The privileged approval request is pending.
Approved: The privileged approval request is approved.
Expired: The privileged approval request is no longer available.
Rejected: The privileged approval request was rejected.
Approve the privileged approval request.
Reject the privileged approval request.
Modify the columns displayed in the table.
Display more rows or a different page of the table.
Go to the My Requests page to manage your privileged approval requests.
